section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study within a wider Portuguese project. Participants were recruited via online advertisements on social networks; initially 514 participants (494 women, 20 men) aged 17-57 completed self-report measures. The dataset was then cleaned to exclude all male participants and female participants younger than 18 or older than 54, but the final sample size after these exclusions is not reported.
